name: Mary Rebecca Adams
milestones: Buried at Cedar Hill Cemetery with Stephen and Harriet Gill, on the opposite side of their monument
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Listed as a niece in Stephen Gill's household in the 1880 census; her father was born in Virginia and her mother in Germany. [Further Research, line 7901]
Still living with the Gills in 1900, a few houses from her brother George. [Further Research, line 8057]
